links.outcome: Consistency of LLM outputs across duplicate runs
links.effect: Output consistency varied by model; Gemini 2.5 Pro gave the most consistent outputs. No numeric consistency results are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro showed highest explanation quality and most consistent outputs, while ChatGPT-4o had shortest response times and highest efficiency.

unlisted_practices: Comparing general (short) versus detailed (structured, guidance-referencing) prompts for LLM extraction of regulatory information; general prompts were more accurate (59.3% vs 44.4%; p = 0.011)

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs extracting FDA regulatory and clinical trial evidence, comparing general vs. detailed structured prompt designs on accuracy, hallucination, and efficiency.

primary.practice: prompt engineering strategy (general vs detailed structured prompts)
